intro.title: Customer Selection & Quick Add
intro.subtitle: Instant patient search, loyalty point tracking, and 3-second walk-in registration

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 4: Fast Customer Selection and Three-Second Quick Add. Tagging regular patients enables reward points, store credit, and purchase history without slowing down your checkout queue.
In the customer search box, type the patient's name or mobile number. Notice Ramesh Kumar appears instantly in the dropdown. Click to select him.
MediFlow immediately displays his profile card: his mobile number, a store credit limit of five thousand rupees, and one hundred and fifty active loyalty reward points ready to redeem.

For a first-time walk-in patient, click New or press Alt plus N. Type the patient's name like Sunita Sharma, enter their ten-digit mobile number, and click Save. Within three seconds, the customer is registered and attached to the bill.
Customer tagging builds patient retention and keeps your pharmacy records organized. In Part 5, we will explore Split-Tender Payments and Cash Change Due using F8.

outro.takeaway: Customer Profiles: Track loyalty points, store credit balances, and digitize walk-in registrations in 3 seconds.
